As of my last update in October 2023, OpenAI's latest flagship model is **GPT-4**. GPT-4 is an advanced language model that builds upon the capabilities of its predecessor, GPT-3, with improvements in various areas such as natural language understanding, generation, and reasoning. It is designed to handle a wide range of tasks with greater accuracy and efficiency.

For the most up-to-date information, you can visit OpenAI's official website or their latest announcements, as they continue to refine and release new models.
